segments.name: Royalties, streaming and similar interests
segments.description: Invests in gold-focused royalty, streaming and similar interests on mining properties operated by third parties.
segments.evidence: The Company conducts its business as a single operating segment, being the investment in royalties, streaming and similar interests.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns revenue from mine operators under royalty and streaming interests, tied to metal production and prices, and from selling streamed commodities to third-party customers.
revenueModel.evidence: For streaming interests, revenue recognition occurs when the relevant commodity received from the stream operator is transferred by the Company to its third-party customers.
